fields.schemeName: Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship For Single Girl Child
fields.briefDescription: Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (SJSGC) is a Fellowship Scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education, for pursuing research work leading to the award of a Ph.D. degree. The target group of this scheme is the ‘single girl child'.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship
fields.schemeName: Advanced Vocational Training Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide innovative, effective and integrated training opportunities for work force who need new skills to enjoy the dignity that comes with employment, independence and self-reliance.

fields.schemeName: Teelu Rauteli Award
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize and honor women and adolescent girls who have made outstanding achievements in various fields such as social work, education, literature, art, culture, courage, and bravery.

fields.schemeName: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Minor Irrigation
fields.briefDescription: The scheme offers loans to farmers for minor irrigation projects, aiming to enhance water access for agriculture. Loan amounts range from ₹65,000/- to ₹1,20,000/- at an interest rate of 11% to 11.75%.

fields.schemeName: Issuance of Free House Sites
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides free residential land sites to eligible individuals from the Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC), and Denotified Communities (DNC) who do not own a house or land, helping them secure housing stability.

fields.schemeName: PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
fields.briefDescription: PM SVANidhi is a micro-credit scheme launched on 1st June 2020 by the MoHUA to provide handholding support to street vendors. The scheme facilitates a working capital collateral-free loan of ₹10,000, with subsequent loans of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 with a 7% interest subsidy.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Visually Challenged Teachers
fields.briefDescription: Financial assistance scheme providing up to ₹36,000 annually to visually challenged permanent college teachers for reader assistance, Braille books, and learning aids. Implemented by University Grants Commission to support teaching, research, and academic independence.

fields.schemeName: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme targets manufacturers of components / sub-assemblies of Air Conditioners & LED Lights and offers 4–6% incentive on incremental sales to boost localization, reduce imports, and build a domestic supply chain.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarships to the Children of Those Engaged in Occupations Involving Cleaning and Prone to Health Hazards
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to children whose parents/guardians belong to one of the following categories, to pursue Pre-Matric education: Tanners, Flayers, Waste Pickers and Persons who are either presently engaged in Manual Scavenging.

fields.schemeName: Prime Minister’s Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide internship opportunities to one crore youth in top 500 companies in five years. Through this Scheme, youth will gain exposure for 12 months to real-life business environment, across varied professions and employment opportunities.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Statistics and Programme Implementation
fields.schemeName: Scheme of Internship for Post-Graduate/Research Students
fields.briefDescription: MoSPI is implementing the scheme of Internship for Post-graduate/Research Students of Statistics/ Mathematical Statistics/ Operations Research/ Economics/ Demography or any of the applied field of Statistics of recognized Universities//Institutions.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of New and Renewable Energy
fields.schemeName: National Renewable Energy Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "National Renewable Energy Internship Scheme" by MNRE provides internship opportunities to facilitate students pursuing undergraduate/graduate/post-graduate degrees (Engineering, Science, Management, Law, etc) or research scholars enrolled in recognized institutes/universities.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana: Gramodyog Vikas Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase productivity and wages of Khadi artisans, improve production infrastructure, boost employment and sales, revive traditional rural skills, modernize sales outlets, and promote marketing and exports.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Development Of North Eastern Region
fields.schemeName: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
fields.briefDescription: The scholarship scheme aims to support students of the North Eastern States undergoing studies in different disciplines at different levels in Institutions inside as well as outside the North-East but within the country.

fields.schemeName: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The Department of Biotechnology has instituted a scheme known as the “Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship”. The scheme is aimed at Indian Nationals who are working overseas in various fields of biotechnology and life sciences and are interested in taking up scientific research positions in India.

fields.schemeName: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for Railway Protection Force
fields.briefDescription: Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for RPF was announced by Hon’ble Prime Minister of India in his address to the nation from the historical Red Ford on 15th August 2005 to encourage higher technical and professional education for the dependent wards of Ex/Serving RPF/RPSF personnel& widows.

fields.schemeName: Research Associates (RA)
fields.briefDescription: The Research Associates (RAs) of the Department of Biotechnology (DBT) in India are individuals who engage in research work under the DBT-Research Associateship Program in Biotechnology and its was started in 1999.

fields.schemeName: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The "Indo-German Science & Technology Centre (IGSTC) Industrial Fellowship Programme" was launched by Secretary, Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India on the occasion of IGSTC’s 11th Foundation Day on 14th June 2021 to support young Indian researchers for industrial exposure in German

fields.schemeName: Prime Minister’s Fellowship for Doctoral Research
fields.briefDescription: Prime Minister’s Fellowship for Doctoral Research scheme is a prestigious initiative of Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), Department of Science & Technology, Government of India towards the advancement of university research engagements in line with industry requirement.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Establishment of Small Scale Poultry Unit (Layer) for livestock owner of Daman & Diu
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims at the economic upliftment of the SC/ST, SMF, and BPL Families. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a subsidy is provided to SC/ST, SMF, and BPL families.

fields.schemeName: Women In Science and Engineering-Societal Challenges with Opportunities Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The “WISE-SCOPE Fellowship” Program was started by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India with the aims to provide opportunity to Women Scientists and Technologists who have completed Ph.D. and want to utilize their S&T knowledge and expertise for the benefit of society.

fields.schemeName: Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Degree)
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by MoE for Girl Students admitted in 1st or 2nd Year of the technical degree course in an AICTE approved institution. The benefits are provided for max. 4 years for first-year admitted students and max. 3 years for second-year admitted students through lateral entry.

fields.schemeName: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- Post Doctoral Industrial Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: This programme is aimed at encouraging Postdoctoral researchers/fresh PhDs in S&T with appreciable track record and having aptitude for applied research and technology development.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship
fields.schemeName: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme-2
fields.briefDescription: To promote apprenticeship training in the country, by providing partial stipend support to the apprentices engaged under the Apprentice Act, 1961, undertaking capacity building of the apprenticeship ecosystem, and providing advocacy assistance to the stakeholders.

fields.schemeName: Post Doctoral Fellowship to Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Candidates
fields.briefDescription: This scheme has been initiated keeping in view social background of candidates from the deprived section of society and to provide them an opportunity to undertake advanced studies and research in Science, Engineering & Technology, Humanities and Social Sciences in Indian Universities/Institutions.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: National Fellowship for Students with Disabilities
fields.briefDescription: A Scheme "National Fellowship For Students With Disabilities" was initiated by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities under the "Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment".

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana
fields.briefDescription: This is a micro-financing programme aiming towards the empowerment of women from underprivileged backgrounds or economically backward areas. Through this scheme, these women can apply for a loan at a nominal interest rate to fulfil their dreams and goals and gain financial independence.

fields.schemeName: RMEWF-Financial Assistance To 100% Disabled Child Of Ex-Servicemen
fields.briefDescription: A scheme to provide financial assistance to Ex-Servicemen or their widows for their 100% disabled child.

fields.schemeName: Internship Scheme Of The Ministry Of Labour & Employment
fields.briefDescription: Through the Internship Scheme, the Ministry of Labour & Employment engage eligible students as “Interns" to work for mutual benefit. The “Interns” shall have an opportunity to know about the Government functioning and Department Policy issues in the Government of India.

fields.schemeName: Education Loan Scheme of NMDFC
fields.briefDescription: Loan of upto ₹20,00,000/- for domestic courses & ₹30,00,000/- for courses abroad under Credit  Line-1 and Credit line -2 is extended to beneficiaries belong to minority communities at 3% p.a. & 8% p.a respectively.

fields.schemeName: Promotion of Exportable surplus of identified spices in NE: Cultivation of NE ginger (Ha)
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to promote the cultivation of ginger in the North Eastern region by supporting farmers with financial assistance for quality planting material, enhancing productivity and quality, and increasing the exportable surplus of spices from the region.

fields.schemeName: Quality Improvement Programme (QIP)
fields.briefDescription: The primary objective of this scheme is to enhance the expertise and capabilities of faculty members in degree and diploma-level institutions across the country. The aim is to enable teachers to acquire Master's and Doctoral degrees and instil in them a culture of research.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Upgradation of Merit of Scheduled Caste Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to upgrade the merit of Scheduled Caste students by providing them with facilities for all round development through education in residential or non-residential schools, addressing their educational deficiencies that prevent them from taking advantage of reservation quotas.

fields.schemeName: Jute Design Resource Centre Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to foster innovation and product diversification in the Jute Diversified Products sector. It provides innovative designs, skill training, and technical specifications to Jute Artisans, Micro Small and Medium Enterprises, Exporters, and Women Self Help Groups.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Construction of Hostels for OBC Boys and Girls
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme aims at providing hostel facilities to students belonging to socially and educationally backward classes, especially from rural areas, to enable them to pursue secondary and higher education.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Pension Scheme to Old Age Persons (Senior Citizen)-DNH&DD
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial support to eligible senior citizens to cater to their basic needs. The scheme benefits senior citizens aged 60 years and above, providing a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- for those aged 60–69 years and ₹2,000/- for those aged 70 years and above.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeShortTitle: SUPPLY OF SCHOOL UNIFORM AND TIE BELT
fields.schemeName: Supply of School Uniform and Tie belt to other than SC/ST Boys Students of Std I to VIII
fields.briefDescription: Supply of School Uniform and Tie belt to other than SC/ST Boys Students of Std I to VIII studying in Govt Schools

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Supply of School Stationery to all Students for IX to XII
fields.briefDescription: Supply of School Stationery to all Students for IX to XII studying in Govt Schools

fields.schemeName: Post Doctoral Fellowship (PRL Funded)
fields.briefDescription: The fellowship offers candidates the opportunity to pursue research in PRL’s cutting-edge science & engineering research areas. The tenure of the fellowship is for a maximum of two years, subject to annual progress reviews. The fellowship provides a competitive stipend, research opportunities.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: PM-YASASVI: Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC, and DNT students (who are not covered under SC, ST, or OBC) is welfare and motivation to the children of these categories by providing financial assistance at pre-matriculation or secondary stage.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students - DNH & DD
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide educational empowerment and financial assistance to OBC, EBC, and DNT students. Through this scheme, ₹4,000/- per annum is provided to eligible students studying in Classes 9 and 10 in Government Schools.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Post Matric Scholarship for students with Disabilities - DNH & DD
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide scholarship assistance and educational support to students with benchmark disabilities. Through this scheme, financial assistance, tuition fee support, maintenance allowance, and related benefits are provided to eligible students with disabilities.

fields.schemeName: Post Graduate Scholarship for University Rank Holders Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to attract talented students towards higher education and promote academic excellence at the postgraduate level. The scholarship is tenable for the full duration of the postgraduate course, subject to a maximum period of two years.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: National Talent Scholarship Postgraduate
fields.briefDescription: Merit-based support through the National Talent Scholarship to the post-graduate students seeking admission in agricultural universities in a state other than the state of their domicile through ICAR All India Entrance Examination (AIEE).

fields.schemeName: Hari Om Ashram Prerit Senior Scientist Award
fields.briefDescription: The Hari Om Ashram Prerit Senior Scientist Award was established to commemorate the birth centenary of Pujya Shri Mota, the founder of the Hari Om Ashram, Nadiad. It is awarded to an eminent Indian scientist for their innovative and outstanding contributions to the field of Science and Technology.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric  Scholarship for Students with  Disabilities, DNH & DD
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides a maintenance allowance of ₹500 per month for day scholars and ₹800 per month for hostellers, a disability allowance of up to ₹4,000 per annum, and a book allowance of ₹1,000 per annum to support the school education of students with disabilities.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Pre Matric Scholarship for SC students- DNH & DD
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the education of Scheduled Caste students studying in Classes IX and X. Through this scheme, annual scholarship assistance of up to ₹7,000/- is provided to eligible students.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers – Pre & Post-Matric
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to fund the pre-matric and post-matric education of wards belonging to specific mine, beedi, and cine workers. It provides annual scholarships between ₹1,000/- and ₹25,000/- based on the student's academic level and course type.

fields.schemeName: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award
fields.briefDescription: Named after the hockey wizard Major Dhyan Chand (1905–79), an Indian legendary field hockey player, "Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award" is the highest sporting honour of India. Instituted in 1991–1992, the award is conferred annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: Netaji Subhas - ICAR International Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to develop competent human resources in agriculture and allied sciences through international doctoral education and research opportunities, while providing fellowship support, travel assistance, and exposure to world-class institutions.
